summary_en: 400,000 shares acquired at 3,110 yen per share (1.10% of outstanding shares), total 1.244 billion yen, via ToSTNeT-3 on November 20, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase via ToSTNeT-3 Off-Hours Transaction
translation_en_brief: On November 19, 2026, the board of Nippon Kanzai Holdings resolved to acquire up to 400,000 shares of common stock via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on November 20, 2026. The acquisition price was set at 3,110 yen per share, the closing price on November 19, 2026 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. The total acquisition amount is 1.244 billion yen, representing 1.10% of outstanding shares (36,320,947 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The purchase order is effective only during the specified ToSTNeT-3 trading session at 8:45 a.m., and partial or non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after the transaction closes on November 20, 2026. The company cited the need for flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business environments as the reason for the acquisition.
